offence_note: Uttering forged documents to obtain provincial funding
sentence_quote: The parties made a joint recommendation that Ms. Kelly receive a conditional sentence of 12 months, to be followed by a period of probation for 12 months, both with numerous conditions.
note: Appeal quashed $97,000 restitution order; CSO and probation inferred from joint recommendation adopted at trial.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, stabbing with a knife
sentence_quote: The sentence, in my view, of three years less time served is indeed a fit sentence and that is the sentence that I will impose.
note: Schizophrenia treated as mitigating; 225 days custody given 338 days enhanced credit.

offence_note: Failure to provide necessaries causing death; drug possession; failure to attend court
sentence_quote: I would impose a sentence of three years in a penitentiary on the count of failure to provide necessaries of life. From that sentence, I would deduct 17 months as credit for pre-disposition custody. This leaves a custodial remanet of 19 months.
note: Execution of the 19 month remanet stayed at Crown request; concurrent one day sentences on other counts.

offence_note: Drug trafficking or importing offence with flight from police
sentence_quote: The term of 14 months selected by the trial judge was appropriate.
note: Closing shown appears to be Chipman J.A. dissent (would substitute jail); majority outcome inferred as conditional sentence standing.

offence_note: Aggravated assault, assault with weapon, unlawful confinement, uttering threats
sentence_quote: Because Mr. Fontaine poses such a high risk, and the Aboriginal and other programs he has taken in the past have not ameliorated that risk, the appropriate sentence in the circumstances was to designate him a dangerous offender.
note: Dangerous offender designation upheld despite failure to apply Gladue; indeterminate term inferred.

offence_note: Break and enter, arson, failure to attend court, failing to stop after accident
sentence_quote: there will be a sentence of two years on the arson. There will be a sentence of four months on the hit and run and there will be a sentence of one month on the failure to appear.
note: Two years concurrent on break and enter and arson; ten-year s.109 prohibition; four months pre-sentence custody not expressly credited.

offence_note: Possession of cocaine for the purpose of trafficking
sentence_quote: the court sentences you to a federal term of imprisonment of two (2) years, commencing today's date.
note: Joint recommendation accepted; DNA order declined.

offence_note: Three aggravated assaults, break and enter, masked face, breach of recognizance
sentence_quote: is a 267-day Custody and Supervision Order followed by 12 months of probation with conditions I will detail shortly.
systemic_quote: The emphasis on accountability is not diminished by considerations of B.(D.)’s experience as a racialized youth drawn into the orbit of criminally-inclined peers. It is informed by this reality.
note: Youth court; 267 days custody and supervision (178 custody, 89 community); about 12 months pre-sentence detention taken into account.

offence_note: Armed robbery, two unlawful confinements, firearm use during flight
sentence_quote: She applies for leave to appeal and, if leave is granted, appeals against a global sentence of seven years imposed by Mr. Justice Melnick on 13 November 1997.
note: Judge set global 9 years then deducted 2 years dead time, leaving 7 years; prison shown before credit.
